description.value: The Abbotsford Recreation Centre (ARC) is a large City of Abbotsford–operated multi-sport facility offering a broad range of fitness and recreation programming to residents and visitors. Located in the heart of Abbotsford, it is a typical municipal recreation complex that touring cyclists might use as a rest and refresh stop. The facility is wheelchair accessible and tagged in OSM as supporting multiple sports.
